name: billing-sslcommerz

envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_ID: Your SSLCOMMERZ store id, from the merchant panel at https://sandbox.sslcommerz.com (sandbox) or https://merchant.sslcommerz.com (live). Required once BILLING_PROVIDER=sslcommerz. Unset, every checkout throws BillingError("invalid_request") naming this key before anything is sent; set but wrong, the gateway refuses the session and it surfaces as provider_error with the gateway's own failedreason.
envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_PASSWORD: The store password issued with the store id, sometimes called the API password. Required once BILLING_PROVIDER=sslcommerz. It is sent on the session-open POST and on every validation call, so a deployed Worker must hold it as a secret (`wrangler secret put SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_PASSWORD`), never in wrangler.jsonc.
envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_MODE: Which gateway host to use: `live` for https://securepay.sslcommerz.com, anything else for the sandbox at https://sandbox.sslcommerz.com. Optional, and it fails safe — only the exact string `live` selects the live gateway, so a typo sends a test payment to the sandbox rather than a real one to production.
envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_CALLBACK_URL: Absolute https origin of your deployed api Worker, with no trailing path — the same origin PUBLIC_API_URL names for the admin app. The provider builds the four callback URLs under it: /billing/callback/sslcommerz/ipn, /return/success, /return/fail and /return/cancel. Required, because a Worker cannot know its own public origin and a wrong one means payments the gateway takes and never reports.
envVars.SSLCOMMERZ_RECEIPT_EMAIL: A real mailbox you own, e.g. billing@yourdomain.com. SSLCOMMERZ requires cus_email on every session and mails its own receipt to it. A provider is handed an opaque billable subject and never learns the subject's address (CONTEXT.md → "Billable subject"), so this is the one address it can name. Required.

removeWarnings: Removing this module does not cancel anything at SSLCOMMERZ, and there is nothing to cancel: this provider stores no card and nothing recurs at the gateway. Subjects simply stop being asked to pay.
The four callback URLs stay registered in the SSLCOMMERZ merchant panel. Remove the IPN URL there, or the gateway keeps posting to an endpoint that now answers 404.
